title: Trap catalog
description: The trap catalog of a module, traps.yaml at the root of its folder: the typical mistakes that the module's tasks catch, each under its local ID, with what the mistake is, the skills it belongs to and what to advise on it. A task names only a trap of the catalog, so that a wrong answer becomes a diagnosis that can be counted. Every field is closed, since a trap tells what mistake a task expects.

description.description: What the mistake is, in the module's explanation language: AI reads it to suggest the trap from the learner's work, and the learner's progress names the mistakes that repeat by it.

skills.description: The skills of the module that the mistake belongs to, by local ID. A trap that belongs to no skill leaves this field out.

trap_advice.description: What to advise the adult or the learner on this mistake, in the module's explanation language: the learner's progress gives it beside a trap that repeats, and it is the fallback text of the first two rungs after a wrong value of the trap that has no text of its own.

additionalProperties.description: A trap of the module, under its local ID.

traps.description: The module's traps, each under its local ID. Their order carries no meaning.
